PLAN "Prenatal Strength 12-Week Program Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Preserve strength, core integrity, and overall functional capacity through pregnancy with safe progression"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 1 Week 1 - Intro to Presses + Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        core:
          dead_bug 3x10-12
          side_plank 3x20-30 seconds per side
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Phase 1 Week 2 - Pressing Foundation + Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 10 minutes moderate
        core:
          bird_dog 3x10 per side
          pallof_press 3x8..12 per side
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Phase 1 Week 3 - Pressing Technique + Core Stability":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        core:
          dead_bug 3x12
          glute_bridge Marching 3x12
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Phase 1 Week 4 - Deload Pressing + Core Work":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          elliptical 8 minutes moderate
        core:
          side_plank 3x20 seconds per side
          plank_knee_tucks 3x10
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 2 Week 1 - Push Emphasis + Core + Cardio + Moderate Intensity":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 12 minutes moderate
        core:
          quadruped_tritis 3x10 per side
          hollow_hold 3x20-40 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Phase 2 Week 2 - Push Intensity Progression + Core Stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          elliptical 8 minutes moderate
        core:
          pallof_press 3x10 per side
          side_plank with knee drop 3x12 per side
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Phase 2 Week 3 - Push Mix + Core + Cardio":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x6..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          walk/jog intervals 6 rounds of 1 minute jog, 2 minutes walk
        core:
          dead_bug 3x12 per side
          overhead_hold 3x20 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 2 Week 4 - Deload/Technique + Push Emphasis + Core Support":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 8 minutes easy
        core:
          plank 3x25-40 seconds
          copenhagen_plank 2x15 seconds per side
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Phase 3 Week 1 - Peak Press Volume + Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          rower 6 minutes moderate
        core:
          pallof_press 3x12 per side
          hanging_leg_raise_restricted 3x6..8
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Phase 3 Week 2 - Press Strength Progression + Core":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          brisk_walk/jog intervals 8 rounds of 1 minute jog, 1:30 walk
        core:
          side_plank with long hold 3x30 seconds per side
          dead_bug with toe taps 3x12 per side
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 3 Week 3 - Push Hypertrophy + Core Variety":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          elliptical 10 minutes moderate
        core:
          knee_to_elbow_plank 3x12 per side
          pallof_press with theraband 3x12 per side
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Phase 3 Week 4 - Peak/Return to prior pace + Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          push_up 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          walking 15 minutes easy cooldown
        core:
          hollow_hold 3x40 seconds
          russian_twist with medicine ball or no-weight 3x12 per side
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds

  DURATION_PER_SESSION: 20..30 minutes
  INTENSITY_GUIDANCE: start at light-moderate; progress to moderate if tolerated
  CAUTIONS: avoid high-impact; monitor for dizziness, shortness of breath, fetal movement changes

  OBJECTIVE:
    - Support fetal development and maternal recovery
    - Maintain lean mass
  ENERGY_REQUIREMENTS:
    - Maintenance + ~300 calories (adjust per clinician)
  MACRONUTRIENTS:
    - Protein 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day
    - Carbs 3–5 g/kg/day
    - Fats to fill remaining calories
  MICRONUTRIENTS: iron, calcium, vitamin D, folate, iodine, magnesium, zinc, choline
  MEAL_TIMING: 3 meals + 2–3 snacks; post-workout protein
  SAFETY_CONSIDERATIONS: prenatal vitamin; avoid high-mercury fish
  MONITORING: weekly weight, appetite, energy
  COORDINATION: with OB

    - Estimate daily energy need: maintenance + ~300 calories (adjust per weight gain, clinician guidance)
    - Monitor weight trajectory; aim for steady, manageable gain per obstetric guidelines
  MACRONUTRIENTS:
    - Protein: 1.6–2.2 g per kg body weight per day (adjust for appetite and renal tolerance)
    - Carbohydrates: 3–5 g per kg body weight per day, emphasize complex carbs and fiber
    - Fats: remaining calories after protein and carbs; focus on sources of omega-3s (ALA, EPA/DHA via fortified foods or supplements if approved)

    - Iron: adequate intake from lean meats, legumes, fortified cereals; supplement per clinician
    - Calcium: 1,000–1,300 mg/day from dairy or fortified alternatives
    - Vitamin D: 600–800 IU/day or as advised
    - Folate: 400–800 mcg/day
    - Iodine: as per guidelines; consider prenatal vitamin
    - Magnesium, zinc, choline: via varied diet or prenatal vitamin

    - Protein at each meal (including a post-workout snack with 20–40 g protein)
    - Hydration: 2.3–3.0 L/day depending on activity and climate

    - Avoid undercooked meats, unpasteurized dairy, high mercury fish; ensure thoroughly cooked foods

    - Modify protein targets if experiencing nausea or fatigue; prioritize protein-rich options

    - If fatigue or nausea affects meals, implement smaller, more frequent protein-rich snacks

    - Achieve pregnancy-appropriate energy balance and macronutrient distribution
